subject: english
stem: Lily told Mia that her coat was wet. What is the safest conclusion?
options: The coat certainly belongs to Lily.
The coat belongs to both because her is plural.
The owner of the coat is unclear.
The coat certainly belongs to Mia.

optionRationales.reason: The coat certainly belongs to Lily.：也缺乏唯一線索。
The coat belongs to both because her is plural.：her 是單數所有格形式。
The owner of the coat is unclear.：兩位女性都可由 her 指代。
The coat certainly belongs to Mia.：最近位置不能保證。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「先找擁有者的人稱與數，再看所有格形式是否需依附後方名詞，並用上下文消除多人物指稱歧義。」可推出 The owner of the coat is unclear.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 The owner of the coat is unclear. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
